card.name: Start of a name or foreign word
card.fires_on: Responds to a word or word piece that begins a proper name or foreign-language term, such as 'erta' in Wiedertaufe, 'La' in LaSalle or La Haya, or 'Sa' in a Sanskrit title. Weaker hits appear on a few ordinary words like 'mother' or 'who'.

modes.description: Middle of a German or Sanskrit word, or the start of a foreign name.

modes.label: La in place names
modes.description: The word La at the start of a place name in English or Spanish text.

modes.label: Ordinary words in drug text
modes.description: A scattered ordinary word in label text, with no shared theme.
modes.example: the potential benefit to the<< mother>> justifies the potential risk to the fetus
